extName.message: Dogear: PDF reader that remembers your page

extDescription.message: Opens every PDF where you left off. No account and no servers: your reading history stays in your browser.

fileAccessNeeded.message: To remember your place in PDFs on your computer, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" on the extension's page.

numberingFileTooltip.message: Numbers count pages in the file: 20 is the 20th page. Click to use the numbers printed in the book.

numberingBookTooltip.message: Numbers are the ones printed in the book: 20 is the page printed as 20. Click to count pages in the file.

historyEmpty.message: Nothing here yet. Open a PDF and it will show up.

historyRemove.message: Remove from history and forget the position

historyNoLink.message: Opened from a file picker, so there is no address to reopen
